summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery errors locals in koruide command scenario

delivery.outcome: Rename the generic error-list local 'errors' to stage-accurate names in each of the seven functions of packages/koruide/src/koruide/command_scenario.py that mutate it: step_errors (_validate_step, the per-step findings accumulator, matching the caller's existing unpack), action_errors (_validate_step_kind), command_errors (_validate_step_command), risk_errors (_validate_step_risk), mode_errors (_validate_mode), header_errors (_scenario_ide_and_steps, the scenario-header ide/steps-presence checks), scenario_errors (_validate_scenario_steps, the per-step aggregation into the scenario report), and scenario_errors for the same-name local in the public validate_ide_command_scenario entry point (coherence rename; that local carries no method mutation). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'errors' group drops from 7 scopes to 0. Each new name lands at 1 scope, so no (file, variable) group grows toward the threshold. Pure rename of function-internal locals and sink parameters; no signature, return shape, dataclass field (ScenarioValidation.errors) or behavior change; no other file touched.
nonGoals: No behavior, validation semantics or interface change
No restructuring into a returned-findings (pure) validator chain; each helper already owns one validation stage, the shared generic name was the defect, not a missing abstraction

No fix for the pre-existing 'warnings' shotgun-surgery group in the same file (5 scopes, not part of this ticket's reported smell) or for findings in other files - minimal scope for this ticket's reported smell only
No rename of locals in other files that happen to use 'errors' (each is an independent local in its own file scope)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local renames only, inside one module. Every function that appends validation findings names its error channel after the validation stage it serves (per-step accumulator, action-kind, missing-command, risk-policy, mode, scenario-header, scenario aggregation); the generic name 'errors' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports an 'errors' mutation group of exactly 7 scopes - _validate_step, _validate_step_kind, _validate_step_command, _validate_step_risk, _validate_mode, _scenario_ide_and_steps, _validate_scenario_steps - matching the ticket's 'spans 7 functions'; after the rename the 'errors' group is empty, the file mutation record count is unchanged (47) and no new (file, variable) group reaches the >= 5 threshold (the pre-existing 'warnings' group at 5 scopes remains untouched and out of scope).
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named errors again and the smell report returns.
